title: GTX 1080 Founders Edition Review & Benchmark
description:
This is the definitive nVidia GeForce GTX 1080 Founders Edition review & benchmark. We test the GTX 1080 vs. GTX 980 Ti, GTX 980, Fury X, & 390X for gaming performance. Full review here: http://www.gamersnexus.net/hwreviews/2438-nvidia-geforce-gtx-1080-founders-edition-review-and-fps-benchmark

Games tested on the GTX 1080 include: DOOM, The Division, Ashes of Singularity, Talos Principle, GTA V, Shadow of Mordor, Metro: Last Light, Tomb Raider. You'll find the GTX 1080 specs, power/TDP, thermal, and FPS benchmarks here. Check our article for full depth.
